identity.name: OLMo-2-1124-7B
identity.summary: OLMo 2 is the next generation of fully open language models, with 7B and 13B variants showing improved MMLU and other evaluation gains over the original OLMo 7B.

training_context.training_data: The model was trained on OLMo-mix-1124 and Dolmino-mix-1124 datasets using a staged training approach. Pretraining Stage 1 used OLMo-Mix-1124 with 4 trillion tokens (1 epoch), and Pretraining Stage 2 used Dolmino-Mix-1124 with 50B tokens (3 runs) merged.
